name: 5F-ADB
summary: 5F-ADB is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid from the indazole-3-carboxamide family, which has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products and has been sold online as a designer drug. 5F-ADB is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor, though it is unclear whether it is selective for this target.

pharmacology.text: 5F-ADB is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor, though it is unclear whether it is selective for this target.

uses.text: 5F-ADB (also known as MDMB-5F-PINACA using systematic EMCDDA nomenclature and 5F-MDMB-PINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid from the indazole-3-carboxamide family, which has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: It is a highly potent synthetic cannabinoid. Reported effects include a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, confusion, paranoia and loss of consciousness. Seizures, psychosis and deaths have been linked to it, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它是效力極強的合成大麻素。已知的反應包括心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、意識混亂、多疑與失去意識。它曾與癲癇發作、精神病及死亡有關，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它是效力极强的合成大麻素。已知的反应包括心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、意识混乱、多疑与失去意识。它曾与癫痫发作、精神病及死亡有关，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: It has been one of the most commonly found synthetic cannabinoids in seized products worldwide, and it has been detected in prisons where it is sprayed onto paper.
fact.zh: 它一直是全球查緝物品中最常見的合成大麻素之一，也曾在監獄中被檢出，做法是把它噴在紙張上。
fact.zhHans: 它一直是全球查缉物品中最常见的合成大麻素之一，也曾在监狱中被检出，做法是把它喷在纸张上。
